programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee menerima tawaran dari Indra berupa uang dan fasilitas mewah jika ia bersedia bergabung dengan tim Archon. Zee belum menyetujui tawaran tersebut, namun hal itu membuatnya sulit berkonsentrasi menjalani aktivitas bersama tim SMBG. Ia sering absen karena gangguan yang diberikan Indra. Hal ini menyebabkan keretakan di dalam tim SMBG.

programme.title: The One S1 E7

Meskipun diwarnai berbagai perdebatan sengit, pada akhirnya mereka menyadari bahwa seluruh tim adalah sebuah keluarga dan harus tetap bersatu.

programme.title: The One S1 E8
programme.desc: Robin berhasil mengatasi gangguan dari tim Archon. Kini tim SMBG siap menghadapi final regional yang akan mengantarkan mereka menjadi juara. Di babak final tersebut, ternyata mereka harus berhadapan dengan tim Archon.

Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E4
programme.desc: Naya merasa gugup ketika Queena memintanya untuk memperkenalkannya kepada Jetta. Saat Naya sedang memikirkan Jetta, tiba-tiba Jetta muncul dan membuat suasana kantin menjadi ramai. Pada saat yang sama, Majja datang dan meminta Jetta untuk pergi. Hampir terjadi pertengkaran, dan Queena yang marah pun meminta Majja untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E3
programme.desc: Nando, seorang anak pengusaha kaya yang didiagnosa terkena kanker dan sisa hidupnya 2 tahun lagi. Untuk melupakan kesedihannya, Nando bekerja keras menjadi manajer restoran. Disaat inilah, dia bertemu Emilia, pelanggan tetapnya yang memiliki hobi meneropong bintang. Kehadiran Emilia memberikan pengaruh baik dalam kesehatan dan hidupnya Nando.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E3
programme.desc: Agar bisa lebih dekat dengan Ravi, Diva memutuskan untuk bergabung dalam panitia roadshow MIC. Sementara itu, Nada meminta Beni untuk menemani Diva ke mana pun pergi, agar ia tidak melakukan hal-hal yang berhubungan dengan Ikatan Cinta.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Dalam film laga yang menegangkan ini, Danny Lee, Jason Pai dan Sun Chien berperan sebagai penegak hukum baru. Namun, tugas mereka untuk membasmi kejahatan dihalangi oleh atasan mereka yang korup.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Pertempuran mematikan yang tak terelakkan demi mendapatkan Pedang Ungu yang tak ternilai. Asisten sutradara Wang Po-yi berperan dalam penulisan naskah film petualangan yang menghibur ini.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: Putri seorang ahli pedang dikejar dan diracun oleh seorang ahli nan kejam saat ia membawa kembali sebuah Pedang Emas yang dicuri ke istana.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: Putri seorang ahli pedang dikejar dan diracun oleh seorang ahli nan kejam saat ia membawa kembali sebuah Pedang Emas yang dicuri ke istana.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Penyanyi Qing Qing dan arsitek Tang Peng Nan adalah pasangan serasi. Ia mengorbankan dirinya untuk membantu Peng Nan pada saat keluarganya mengalami kesulitan. Namun, mereka putus karena kesalahpahaman.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan dan muridnya Fan bekerja mengangkut zombie. Saat mereka berdua melarikan diri, ternyata salah satu dari mereka sebenarnya adalah seorang pria yang sedang menyamar dan kabur dari musuh-musuhnya.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Setelah sukses menyutradarai film pertamanya, Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung King-tin menyajikan film komedi bertema benturan budaya ketika seorang petani asal Tiongkok Daratan memboyong keluarganya ke Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Seorang menteri nan jahat memakai 12 medali emas, lambang keputusan kaisar tertinggi, untuk memanggil prajurit perang Yueh Fei kembali dari garis depan demi membunuhnya. Sekelompok pejuang pun mencoba menghentikannya.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: Seorang nelayan muda bernama Chin Hu jatuh cinta dengan teman masa kecilnya, Hsiao Yu. Namun, putra satu-satunya preman di sana terpukau pada kecantikan Hsiao Yu dan mencoba segala cara untuk mendekatinya.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: Penduduk Kota Liu terpaksa melarikan diri saat geng Macan Hitam yang kejam menyerang kota. Namun, para penduduk berhasil menyembunyikan semua emas dan harta mereka di sebuah lembah.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu berperan sebagai putra seorang kepala polisi, yang jatuh cinta pada seorang penari nan seksi. Saat sang gadis diperkosa, ia bersumpah untuk menentang ayahnya dan membalas dendam!

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou dikhianati oleh istrinya dan dibunuh oleh kekasihnya, Fung, yang merupakan bos dari sebuah sekolah seni bela diri. Xiao Lou pun mengetahui kematian saudaranya yang tragis dan bertekad untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Komedi yang menggelikan ini menampilkan seorang pria lugu bernama Ah Niu. Dia pergi ke Hong Kong dan terus-menerus dieksploitasi dan dimanfaatkan, bahkan ditangkap dan dipenjara.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: Setelah Kuil Shaolin dihancurkan, lima orang siswa belajar teknik-teknik Shaolin untuk mengalahkan musuh-musuh mereka yang dipimpin oleh Ching. Namun, ada seorang 'pengkhianat' di antara mereka. Siapakah ia?

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun berperan sebagai pemain pengganti yang disewa oleh sebuah band populer setelah pemain drum mereka yang egois mengundurkan diri untuk bergabung dengan band saingan mereka.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng berperan sebagai seorang pria yang konon hanya bisa dibunuh oleh sebuah pedang yang ditempa dengan tetesan air mata.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping dan Su adalah sepasang kekasih yang mengelola agen perjalanan khusus liburan ke Asia Tenggara. Seorang kepala sekolah bernama Tung beserta murid-muridnya bergabung dalam tur yang dipimpin oleh Ping.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: Setelah seorang pemerkosa keji membunuh sang guru dan seluruh klannya, Si Buddha Besi bertekad untuk membalas dendam. Namun tentu saja, ia membutuhkan sebuah pedang sakti.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta menemukan bahwa pasokan air di desanya telah terkontaminasi oleh kelelawar, dan saat sedang menggali sumur untuk mencari sumber air baru, ia tanpa sengaja menemukan mayat seorang pendeta Barat yang jahat.

programme.title: Gorgeous (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang gadis romantis melakukan perjalanan ke Hong Kong untuk mencari cinta sejati, namun bertemu dengan seorang petarung profesional yang baik hati dan mulai membuatnya jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Ip Man (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Selama invasi Jepang ke Tiongkok, seorang ahli bela diri kaya terpaksa meninggalkan rumahnya ketika kotanya diduduki. Dengan sedikit sumber penghidupan, Ip Man dan penduduk kota yang tersisa harus menemukan cara untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Seluruh sekolah disandera saat kompetisi pidato bahasa Inggris berlangsung. Ip Man pun memutuskan untuk bangkit dan menghadapi krisis, serta menemukan bahwa dalangnya adalah sang guru dan teman masa kecilnya.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' mengisahkan tentang Austen Kittredge yang berusia sepuluh tahun, yang dikirim oleh ayahnya untuk tinggal di pertanian kakek-neneknya di Vermont. Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

programme.desc: Franz, sebagai yang terkecil di kelas, sangat terbuka untuk menerima saran. Ketika Franz menemukan seorang influencer, kedua sahabatnya skeptis. Akhirnya, ketiganya menemukan kembali apa yang mereka pikir telah hilang: persahabatan terbesar di dunia.

programme.title: Owls & Mice
programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Ia berusaha mendapatkan teman di sekolah barunya sebelum perkemahan musim gugur sekolah dimulai, tetapi ternyata hal itu lebih sulit dari yang dibayangkannya. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Takut orang tuanya akan membunuh Peepeep saat ia pergi, Meral diam-diam membawanya ikut serta. Berkat tikus kecil itu, Meral mendapatkan beberapa teman baru yang tak terduga. Ketika seekor burung hantu menangkap tikus kecil tersebut, Meral menyalahkan teman-teman barunya. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. OWLS & MICE adalah sekuel dari FROGS & TOADS yang sukses dan memenangkan berbagai penghargaan, dari penulis dan sutradara yang sama, Simone van Dusseldorp.

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 47
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS mempersembahkan episode Greatest Classics yang menarik lainnya, menghadirkan lebih banyak aksi yang menampilkan para petinju terhebat dalam sejarah tinju. Salah satu petinju terhebat sepanjang masa akan tampil hanya satu tahun setelah menjalani debut profesionalnya, saat "Pretty Boy" dengan rekor 10-0, Floyd Mayweather - jauh sebelum ia menjadi "Money" - akan menghadapi ujian berat melawan Felipe Garcia dari Meksiko. Mayweather telah menunjukkan bakat yang akan membuatnya menjadi superstar dunia, dengan kecepatan kilat, pertahanan yang luar biasa, dan kekuatan yang mengejutkan untuk pria seukurannya. Saksikan Floyd Mayweather yang masih berusia 20 tahun dalam episode Greatest Classics, di FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Ortiz Vs Maidana
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah pertarungan antara dua atlet pencetak KO, saat Victor Ortiz, yang datang dengan delapan kemenangan KO beruntun, akan menghadapi Marcos Maidana, yang telah mencetak KO dalam 24 dari 25 kemenangannya. Pemenang dari laga ini akan dinobatkan sebagai juara sementara kelas welter ringan WBA.

Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! programme.title: Numberblocks & Colourblcoks
programme.desc: Numberblocks & Colourblcoks

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.title: Tayo The Little Bus

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan dengan senang hati hidup bersama, bus kecil tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak hal yang harus dipelajari tayo. tayo dan teman-temannya, rogi, lani dan gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: Pororo The Little Penguin
programme.desc: Pororo The Little Penguin

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. Mereka semua memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berbeda, yang terkadang menyebabkan sedikit masalah di dunia musim dingin yang tenang. tetapi selalu bersama-sama, setiap hari adalah petualangan di mana mereka belajar semua pelajaran hidup, baik besar maupun kecil !

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

Meskipun Nayla kerap bersikap dingin dan tidak mengakuinya sebagai anak, Intan tetap setia mendampingi dan menyayanginya dengan penuh kesabaran. Di tengah keterbatasan tersebut, kehidupan mereka semakin diuji oleh kemunculan rahasia asal-usul keluarga, pengkhianatan orang-orang terdekat, serta berbagai konflik yang memisahkan mereka, namun kasih sayang Intan terus menjadi harapan utama bagi kesembuhan sang ibu.

Berbagai rintangan pun menguji kesetiaan cinta mereka.

programme.title: Cinta Tanpa Karena

Belum lagi rencana perjodohan Nuna bersama seorang pengusaha sukses bernama Ghani. Sampai suatu ketika Dipta terpaksa harus bertugas ke luar kota, tapi tanpa disangka tragedi besar terjadi tepat saat Nuna positif hamil.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Tertulis Untuk Kita (Tayang Perdana)

Keduanya berusaha membongkar kejahatan Hardiman, di tengah konflik keluarga, persaingan bisnis, dan kisah cinta yang tumbuh di antara mereka.

programme.title: Tertulis Untuk Kita (RCTI)

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji

Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Sera harus menanggung kesalahan yang tidak pernah ia perbuat, sementara Kenzi menyimpan rasa bersalah atas kejadian yang mengubah hidup Sera. Saat kebenaran mulai terungkap, apakah semuanya masih bisa diperbaiki?

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Amira perempuan cantik, baik hati, dan selalu positif dalam memandang hidup. Kehidupannya berjalan baik-baik saja namun setelah kematian suami dan putrinya serta masalah yang datang bertubi-tubi membuatnya menjadi semakin terpuruk untuk melanjutkan hidupnya.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)
programme.desc: Pihu, arwah seorang anak perempuan berusia tujuh tahun, berusaha melindungi ibunya, Anandita, dari segala bahaya dengan bantuan teman sekaligus anak baptisnya, Krishna.

programme.title: Terikat Takdir
programme.desc: Bhootu adalah hantu kecil yang ceria dan senang membantu orang lain. Meski niat baiknya sering menimbulkan kejadian lucu dan masalah tak terduga, ia selalu membawa kebahagiaan bagi orang-orang di sekitarnya.

programme.title: Jangan Bercerai Bunda
programme.desc: Nabilla, seorang ibu dan pengusaha yang memiliki tiga orang anak. Dalam perjalanan rumah tangganya bersama Arga sang suami, lika-liku pun hadir menghampiri. Terungkapnya kejadian bahwa Arga berselingkuh bersama wanita lain membuat Nabilla terdesak dalam kondisi penuh pilihan.

programme.title: RCTI
programme.desc: RCTI menawarkan beragam program termasuk serial drama, film box office, acara olahraga, pencarian bakat, reality show dan musik, program ulang tahun dan penghargaan, serta berbagai infotainment.

programme.title: Anak Jalanan
programme.desc: Boy, pemimpin geng motor, jatuh cinta pada Reva dan terkejut saat mengetahui bahwa ibu tiri Reva adalah mantan kekasihnya. Sementara itu, masa depan gengnya masih belum pasti.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
programme.desc: Seorang taipan korup membunuh saksi kejahatan. Hanya pacar seorang pengusaha yang memiliki hubungan dengan pemerintah Tiongkok yang melihat kejadian tersebut. Pengawal dari Beijing membantu polisi Hong Kong melindunginya. Namun, ia dan saksi tersebut mulai memiliki perasaan, yang memperumit keadaan.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda dengan kemampuan teleportasi tiba-tiba menemukan dirinya di tengah perang kuno antara orang-orang seperti dia dan para pemusnah massal mereka.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: Seorang navigator yang kecewa, setelah ditembak jatuh di Bosnia yang dilanda perang, melarikan diri dari militer setempat dan juga seorang pembunuh, sementara komandan atasannya mempertaruhkan segalanya untuk menyelamatkannya.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: Bencana di terowongan New York saat ledakan meruntuhkan kedua ujungnya. Seorang pahlawan mencoba membantu orang-orang di dalamnya menemukan jalan keluar.

programme.title: White House Down
programme.desc: Saat melakukan tur ke Gedung Putih bersama putrinya yang masih kecil, seorang anggota polisi beraksi untuk melindungi anaknya dan sang presiden dari sekelompok penyusup paramiliter yang bersenjata lengkap.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri berjuang mempertahankan pernikahan mereka, hingga akhirnya mereka menyadari bahwa masing-masing diam-diam bekerja sebagai pembunuh bayaran. Kini, tugas mereka justru mengharuskan mereka untuk saling membunuh.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Ye Mu Xi adalah gadis cerdas dan energik yang akhirnya duduk di bangku kelas 1 SMA. Dia sangat bersemangat untuk tahun ajaran baru karena sekarang dia akhirnya akan berpisah dari teman masa kecilnya yang menyebalkan, Liao Dan Yi. Karena merasa hancur, dia menyusun rencana untuk merebut gelar ketua kelas dari teman masa kecilnya yang sempurna.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: Seorang pemburu hadiah ditawari $250.000 oleh CIA untuk menangkap teroris di balik pemboman bioskop di Los Angeles. Dia keluar dari CIA karena tidak bisa mempercayai mereka. Bisakah mereka dipercaya sekarang? Bisakah dia menghentikan para teroris?

programme.title: Across The Tracks
programme.desc: Dua bersaudara: yang satu seorang pemalas pengedar narkoba, sementara yang lain adalah "anak teladan" yang pekerja keras. Ketika yang satu mulai memperbaiki diri dengan menjadi bintang atletik di sekolah menengah, yang lain merasa iri dan terjerumus ke dalam alkohol.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.desc: Ditto mengisahkan seorang mahasiswa teknik di sebuah universitas bernama Kim Yong. Dia mulai masuk kuliah tahun 1995, namun harus cuti hingga tahun 1999 karena menjalani wajib militer. Suatu hari, Yong menemukan sebuah radio antik yang bisa terhubung dengan masa depan. Yong berkomunikasi dengan Kim Mu-Nee, seorang mahasiswi yang hidup dimasa sekarang, berkuliah di jurusan sosiologi. programme.desc: UFC Ultimate Knockouts celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month. See Edson Barboza, Polyana Viana, Marlon Vera, and more.

programme.title: UFC Countdown - UFC 322: Della Maddalena vs Makhachev
programme.desc: UFC 322 Countdown previews a massive title-fight double header as Islam Makhachev moves up to challenge welterweight champ Jack Della Maddalena, and Zhang Weili faces dominant flyweight queen Valentina Shevchenko

programme.title: LALIGA LEGENDS - PEP GUARDIOLA
programme.desc: More than a title-winning machine, Pep Guardiola changed the face of football. Trace the evolution of his famed “tiki-taka” style of play that propelled the likes of Messi, Xavi, Iniesta and Busquets to footballing royalty.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling - Main
programme.desc: On Saturday, November 21, UFC returns to ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar for a second consecutive year, bringing with it a UFC Fight Night event headlined by a crucial light heavyweight clash between former champion Jiri Prochazka and unbeaten rising star Navajo Stirling. The 34-year-old Prochazka has been a mainstay in the title picture since arriving in the promotion in 2021, having won the title at UFC 275 and since registered stoppage wins over former champ Jamahal Hill and title challenger Khalil Rountree Jr.

programme.title: LALIGA LEGENDS - PEP GUARDIOLA
programme.desc: More than a title-winning machine, Pep Guardiola changed the face of football. Trace the evolution of his famed “tiki-taka” style of play that propelled the likes of Messi, Xavi, Iniesta and Busquets to footballing royalty.

programme.title: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit - Main
programme.desc: Each trip UFC has made to Madison Square Garden has been momentous and this year will be no different as UFC 334 delivers not one, but two massive championship fights. In the main event, newly minted undisputed heavyweight champion Ciryl “Bon Gamin” Gane puts the title on the line against brash American lightning rod Josh Hokit in a five-round battle that will reshape the direction of the division

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.sub-title: Big Bug Problem (Pt. 2) / Maeklong Market Madness
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet deliver a fan letter to Trevor, a young musician and old friend of the Super Wings. When he learns his biggest fan is in the hospital, Trevor really wants to go perform for him too, but their tour bus breaks down in the middle of the desert. A welcome ceremony at the National Aviation Museum in Seoul is being held for Korea's oldest plane. But the old plane crashes on the way!

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Great White Summer
programme.desc: From the peaks of Cape Cod's surfing waves to the murky depths below, trouble runs deep on this beloved New England seashore after the first fatal shark attack in eighty years upends the community. With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Mouse Trap
programme.desc: Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: Two for the Money
programme.desc: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in China III
programme.desc: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

programme.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
programme.desc: Newly released from a mental institution, Ricky (Antonio Banderas) heads straight for a reunion with the love of his life, B-movie actress Marina (Victoria Abril). The trouble is, Marina doesn't remember him -- or the fling they had during her years as a junkie and porn star. Determined to make Marina love him, Ricky barges into her apartment and ties her up. With a captive audience, Ricky is sure it's only a matter of time before his beloved returns his affections.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Idealistic police cadet Chan Wing-Yan (Tony Leung) is recruited by Police Superintendent Wong (Anthony Wong) to go deep undercover as a member of the criminal Triad society. Into the same cadet class, crime boss Hon Sam (Eric Tsang) installs new Triad member Lau Kin Ming (Andy Lau) to become a long-term mole for the gang. A decade later, both have risen through the ranks in their respective aliases -- but when both of their covers are in danger of being blown, a game of life and death ensues.

programme.title: Yakuza Wolf 2
programme.desc: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

programme.title: To Kill With Intrigue
programme.desc: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in China
programme.desc: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until a group of intruders, led by Rose, breaks in. They plan to steal her family's priceless collection of artworks, but their reckless ambition is outmatched only by Rose's opportunism. As the stakes grow even higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: An idyllic lakeside vacation home is terrorized by Paul (Arno Frisch) and Peter (Frank Giering), a pair of deeply disturbed young men. When the fearful Anna (Susanne Lothar) is home alone, the two men drop by for a visit that quickly turns violent and terrifying. Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: JCVD
programme.desc: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

programme.title: Downfall
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
programme.desc: An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

programme.title: Escape to Athena
programme.desc: A ragtag group of prisoners—Italian chef Bruno (Sonny Bono), British archeology professor Blake (David Niven), American soldier Nat (Richard Roundtree) and Greek prostitute Eleana (Claudia Cardinale) —befriend each other in a Greek POW camp run by Otto Hecht (Roger Moore), an art-loving Nazi officer. With the help of local resistance fighters, the inmates plot to escape and steal valuable artifacts from a heavily guarded monastery that's used as a storehouse.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Corky (Anthony Hopkins), a failed magician, adopts a new ventriloquist act with an abrasive dummy named Fats, and suddenly finds himself lined up for a television show. When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.

programme.title: 99 Homes
programme.desc: A desperate construction worker (Andrew Garfield) reluctantly accepts a job with the ruthless real-estate broker (Michael Shannon) who evicted him and his family from their home.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

programme.title: Before I Go to Sleep
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow
programme.desc: A Hong Kong policeman blames his reformed-gangster brother (Chow Yun-Fat) for the death of their father.

programme.title: Basquiat
programme.desc: Despite living a life of extreme poverty in Brooklyn, graffiti artist Jean-Michel Basquiat (Jeffrey Wright) strives to rise up through the heady New York art scene of the 1970s and 1980s. He becomes the brightest star of neo-Expressionist painting and one of the most successful painters of his time, and even develops a friendship with Andy Warhol (David Bowie). But Basquiat's tumultuous life, specifically his addiction to heroin, overshadows his rise to fame, threatening all.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: A low-level drug dealer joins forces with an ambitious cop to bring down a psychotic cartel kingpin.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

programme.title: God of War
programme.desc: A maverick commander and a young general join forces to battle pirates who pillage small villages in 16th-century China. The violent clash of wits and weapons will ultimately decide who rules the land.

programme.title: God of War 2
programme.desc: Benevolent healer Seon-ui discovers a divine medicinal substance called 19; she names it Il-yeo-po, and they become friends until Dong Zhuo's soldiers forcibly seize Il-yeo-po.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Honed from childhood to be an elite assassin, Sook-hee embarks on a rampage of violence and revenge to finally earn her freedom and escape her past.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: Released from prison, a kung-fu expert tries to help the police find a vicious serial killer who targets martial-arts masters.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman who is going blind is forced to raise his sword again to save his daughter, who has been kidnapped by a slave dealer.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Two high school girls who are about to graduate also happen to be highly-skilled assassins. When the organization that employs them orders them to share a room, their relationship turns sour.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahiro must pay four years of overdue fees or lose their membership in their assassin guild. They take part-time jobs, but find themselves in the middle of an armed robbery and being hunted by other assassins.

programme.title: Preman: The Silent Fury
programme.desc: After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies to protect his child.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: A vengeful crime boss forms an unlikely partnership with a detective, to catch the elusive serial killer who attacked him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: Released from prison, a kung-fu expert tries to help the police find a vicious serial killer who targets martial-arts masters.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: A vengeful crime boss forms an unlikely partnership with a detective, to catch the elusive serial killer who attacked him.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Blades
programme.desc: Three sworn brothers are tasked with annihilating a corrupt fugitive and his followers, but a mistake reveals the brothers are being used as pawns in a deadly game filled with secrets, conspiracies and lethal consequences.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Blades 2
programme.desc: A general was forced to kill his partner in an operation and must try to avoid being found guilty while being blackmailed by a mysterious woman. Turns out there is a bigger scheme behind all this.

programme.title: Gundala
programme.desc: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.

programme.title: Night of the Assassin
programme.desc: A hired assassin is paid to assassinate the king.

programme.title: The Rise of Hero
programme.desc: Huang Feihong wants to make a living in Guangzhou. With the help of Zhou Shisan and Lu Yibai, he is finally allowed to take an exam in Guangzhou, and he may be able to study abroad. But after he gets there, he discovers a conspiracy among city leaders and the conservatives in the court led by Eunuch Hai, who wants to end the Studying Abroad Campaign launched by the Westernization Movement.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Blades
programme.desc: Three sworn brothers are tasked with annihilating a corrupt fugitive and his followers, but a mistake reveals the brothers are being used as pawns in a deadly game filled with secrets, conspiracies and lethal consequences.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Blades 2
programme.desc: A general was forced to kill his partner in an operation and must try to avoid being found guilty while being blackmailed by a mysterious woman. Turns out there is a bigger scheme behind all this.

programme.title: Gundala
programme.desc: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
